claims.statement: On bls12-381-g1-ecdlp-plain (input T=[x]P0, x uniform in [0,r), no auxiliary powers), the algorithm in this package recovers and verifies x by [x]G=T with measured probability 0.2825 (one-sided Clopper-Pearson lower bound 0.2694, then 0.26915 after the cap-loss CP-95 upper bound 9.357e-4) at the exact ledger budget, measured on the shipped escape-armed walk at 715,000,012 classes, 16 walkers, 1,687 steps per walker, 3,200 trials, visits/sqrt(N)=1.009444 against the ledger shape 1.0096963, using at most 2^126.266 native-equivalent work units at C=2000. The matched no-escape control on the SAME starts succeeds 0.0050, so the two-step escape repair is worth +0.2775 on identical trajectories, and all 3,200 per-pair prefix traces are byte-identical up to the branch step (evidence/census-v20n.json:matched_pairs). Residual absorption resolved by cycle length: 2-cycles 0 of 3,200, 3-cycles 0 of 3,200, >=4-cycles 3,160 of 3,200; the lag-2/3 extension buys +0.000625 and is shipped as a measured immaterial row. The production-shape model 1-exp(-S(S-1)(w-1)/(2Nw)) = 0.3995 propagated through the measured coalescence ratio 0.774365 and detection factor 0.96706 gives 0.2992 point and 0.2784 at the CP-95 coalescence bound, so the decomposition is BELOW the 0.39 floor and is reported as such, not asserted. Absorption is measured on the repaired predecessor-dependent process at two sizes (16,384 starts each, P(absorbed)=1.0, period_2=0, three-cycle share 0.0263 -> 0.0007) with a re-pin mutation control that moves the mass by 0.7810; the restart price is regenerated by script from itemised 383-instruction products (476.644 ref per scalar action, 1,485.1600 ref per fresh start) and consumed by ledger.py; scripts/selfaudit.py enforces every cited path and field and catches a planted wrong path.

title: Plain G1 v20o: matched-pair census (3,200/3,200 prefix-equal, escape +0.2775), cycle-length split with lag-3 arm, direct cap-loss row, propagated decomposition 0.2784 - 126.266
